relations.rationale: Jude's practicing openings has no bearing on Xavi's height or shelf access.
Jude's eagerness to try a variation is unrelated to the timing of Ivo's arrival.
Jude's eagerness to try a new variation against an unfamiliar opponent could plausibly lead to a longer, unresolved game, slightly increasing likelihood of unfinished games.
If the standard rating system is being used, it's plausible that newer members unfamiliar with it found it confusing, supporting the claim.
The scoring system used for the match has no connection to the advisor's brief visit to check attendance.
Whether Xavi drove the minibus is unrelated to his height helping him reach shelves.
Ivo's arrival time relative to Jude has no bearing on the advisor's attendance check.
Ivo arriving before Jude is a separate fact from Tess arriving before Jude, with no logical connection between them.
The advisor walking in to check attendance is consistent with and plausibly the occasion when they left the scoresheets, supporting the claim.
Xavi being taller than most younger members directly supports the claim that his height helps him reach the higher shelf.
Xavi's height relative to others has no bearing on whether games remained unfinished.
Tess arriving before Jude has no logical connection to whether games were unfinished by session's end.
Unfinished games at session's end is unrelated to Nell's promise to schedule a follow-up meeting before the tournament.
